_about: Per-sheet fact/QA rubric for the Step On It sprite remaster. 'what' = what the sprite depicts (from refs/StepOnItRefCard.pdf, the game code, and pixel inspection); 'keep' = the salient details that MUST survive an upscale; 'method' = how sprites_uhd is produced for this sheet; 'why' = the faithfulness rationale. Used to audit upscales with vision so features (legs, propellers, symbols, faces, shield patterns) are not smoothed away. AI = Real-ESRGAN x4 supersampled to 16x then down to 8x + source chroma/detail refine (best for smooth 3D shapes); hqx = hqx pixel-art scaler (x4) then NEAREST to 8x (crisp, faithful -- for text/symbols/thin-detail/geometry the model would mangle).

ant_sprites.what: red ant enemy (50 pts), segmented body, six thin white/grey legs, antennae
ant_sprites.keep: the thin legs and antennae as distinct strokes
ant_sprites.why: AI melts the thin legs into solid white bars

ant_stride_test.what: ant walk-cycle test frames (same creature as ant_sprites)

beenie_sprites.what: propeller-beanie robot enemy (750 pts), red cap + spinning propeller, small face, blue body, green arm
beenie_sprites.why: AI blobs the thin propeller and warps the small face

bigger_mblock.what: the creeper -- a large moving block, red/blue striped
bigger_mblock.why: geometric tile; AI smears it and a soft edge leaks the cell behind

block_sprites.what: playfield blocks: beveled colour tiles, cracked/breaking frames, green/red dither 'static' tiles
block_sprites.keep: bevels, crack lines, the dither texture, hard edges
block_sprites.why: geometry + fine dither; AI mushes both

bp_30fps_all_but_jump.what: Player One 'Ted' (blue) 30fps animation, all but jump
bp_30fps_all_but_jump.keep: body proportions, blue shirt / red pants / brown hair
bp_30fps_all_but_jump.why: big smooth character body; AI supersample is faithful and less pixely

BP_sprites.why: big smooth character; AI faithful and smoother

cannon_sprites.what: cannonballs (red/blue split beach-ball look), varying sizes
cannon_sprites.why: plain 2-colour balls; crisp hqx is faithful and the tiny ones deviate too much under AI

disk_sprites.what: green sphere with a red 3D star/pinwheel motif (spinning pickup/hazard)
disk_sprites.keep: glossy green sphere + the red star
disk_sprites.why: smooth 3D object -- AI gives a proper glossy sphere; hqx-then-upscale was blurry/pixely

extra_s.what: HUD glyphs: 'Bonus'/'Score'/'GAME OVER', digits 0-9, 2x-5x multipliers, Board#, key/potion/arrow icons
extra_s.why: AI turns tiny text/digits into noise

Gargoyle_sprites.what: stone gargoyle enemy, bat wings, horns, snarling face
Gargoyle_sprites.why: large smooth body; AI faithful (verified high SSIM)

goody_sprites.what: pickups: present boxes with faces, keys, potions, multiplier badges, coins, shields, chest
goody_sprites.keep: the faces, badge text, key/potion icons
goody_sprites.why: AI warps the faces and mangles the small badge text/icons

hammer_sprites.why: large smooth body; AI faithful (high SSIM)

hippo_sprites.what: hippo enemy (200 pts), green, big mouth/teeth

knight_sprites.what: armoured knight enemy, silver plate armour, gold Celtic-knot shield
knight_sprites.keep: armour plate lines, the shield's woven knot pattern
knight_sprites.why: large sculpted body; AI + detail-refine restores plate/shield detail

master_s_objects.what: game symbols/objects: blue '?'/numerals on red (mystery blocks), diamonds, clovers, arrows
master_s_objects.why: AI bloats/distorts the '?' and numeral symbols

ostrich_sprites.what: ostrich enemy (100 pts), pink body, green wings, long neck, big eyes
ostrich_sprites.why: large smooth body; AI faithful (feet colour fixed by refine)

piggy_sprites.what: piggy enemy (250 pts), pink, curly horns, snout

robo_sprites.what: robot enemy, red shell, white ball joints, red feet
robo_sprites.why: large smooth body; AI faithful (high SSIM)

smiley_sprites.what: round face enemy ('Wheelie', 300 pts), red face, white eyes/mouth
smiley_sprites.why: large round face; AI keeps the features and looks smooth

spin_ind_sprite_family.what: spin indicators: white shield/shoe/arrow icons with gold trim
spin_ind_sprite_family.why: small UI-ish icons; keep crisp and faithful

spinner_sprites.what: spinner tiles: red bars with blue balls on a green base
spinner_sprites.keep: the bars and blue balls as distinct parts
spinner_sprites.why: AI melts the thin bars/balls together

Stop_Go_sprite_family.what: Stop/Go flip-sign animation in 4 colours: red/green octagon signs reading 'Stop'/'Go', rotating edge-on between
Stop_Go_sprite_family.keep: legible 'Stop'/'Go' text on the front-facing frames
Stop_Go_sprite_family.why: the source text is low-contrast red-on-red and hqx mushes it; AI renders clean legible signs. Edge-on transition frames go slivery but flash by. (Enhancement over the muddy source, so SSIM is intentionally lower.)

teeth_sprites.what: chattering-teeth enemy, red gums, white teeth
teeth_sprites.why: large smooth body; AI faithful (high SSIM)

transporter.what: transporter portal: red X over a face/portal
transporter.keep: the crisp red X, face behind
transporter.why: geometric X + small; keep the X crisp and faithful

walker_sprites.what: walking enemy (pale creature) plus red bomb frames
walker_sprites.why: large smooth body; AI faithful (high SSIM)

weapons.what: magic-ball weapon: red/white pinwheel spiral ball
weapons.keep: the peppermint spiral, round glossy ball
weapons.why: smooth 3D ball -- AI renders a glossy candy-spiral sphere; hqx-then-upscale was blurry
